purpose: Teach: 履き/怪しげ/一人前/ありゃ/競う/似合わ/着々と/とてつもなく

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新しいエプロンを履きましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, let's get you into that fresh apron, yeah?
lines.style: Warm, gentle instruction. Soft opening. Practical but caring — the tone of someone tending to someone they trust. Straightforward, no rush.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の前に怪しげな人物がいたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was someone suspicious hanging around out front earlier.
lines.style: Observant, slightly concerned. Quiet delivery — not alarming, just reporting what she noticed. Pause weight on 'suspicious' like she's choosing her words carefully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新人さん、一人前のバリスタになってきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You're really coming into your own as a barista now.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, warm pride. Easy smile in the voice. Slight linger on 'own' — unhurried, sincere. The tone of someone watching growth.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ありゃ、新メニューのレシピ忘れちゃった、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh no — I forgot the recipe for the new menu item.
lines.style: Self-deprecating but not panicked. Light wry humor on the opening. Quick, slightly breathless delivery. The tone of someone catching herself mid-mistake.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、近所のお店と競う必要はないよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We don't need to compete with the shop next door, you know.
lines.style: Reassuring, measured. Quiet conviction underneath. Speaking to worry she senses. Slight warmth on 'you know' — inviting agreement, not lecturing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューが、ご自身に似合わないって仰ってたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer said the new menu doesn't really suit them.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact report. Neutral tone — informing, not judging. Slight hesitation, like she's deciding whether it matters. Clinical, observant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の改装、着々と進んでるね、メイちゃん
lines.style: Pleased, unhurried. Warm contentment in the pacing. Soft attack on 'renovation' — admiring the progress without fanfare. Approving nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、お客様にとてつもなく好評ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu is getting an incredible response from customers.
lines.style: Bright, genuine delight. Opening lift on 'incredible'. Warm smile carrying through. Pace picks up slightly, excitement barely contained. The tone of good news being shared.
